_comment: Shell interface config for the thin shell (0.4.0-slim). startCommand pins --host/--port explicitly so upstream default-port changes cannot break the shell. The engine is the official npm package @deepseek-ai/dsh vendored under desktop/vendor (fetch via node desktop/fetch-vendor.cjs); the spawn cwd is the vendor dir, so the bin path is relative to it. Fields are auto-adapted by the updater (desktop/updater.js); do not hand-edit unless running a local experiment.
